title: Use a single structured prompt in Seedance 2.5 with a title, a detailed style…
content:
Use a single structured prompt in Seedance 2.5 with a title, a detailed style block (e.g., 3D Pixar family animation, warm cinematic lighting, cinematic camera, smooth transitions, no subtitles), and a shot-by-shot list with timecodes to generate a full 30s narrative.

Specify each shot with time range, shot type (e.g., WIDE, TRACKING, EPIC REVEAL, MONTAGE, FINAL GAG), action description, and explicit camera direction (e.g., slow push-in, continuous tracking ending in burst of light, massive crane reveal, whip-pan montage, dynamic handheld) to control pacing and camera movement.

Include “smooth transitions” and define montage camera language (fast energetic whip-pan, rapid cinematic cuts) to get high-energy multi-beat sequences without separate prompts.

Add audio direction directly in the style field (e.g., beautiful orchestral soundtrack mixed with upbeat festival music) to guide the intended soundtrack vibe.
